large_guidance:

- Use a channels-last (NDHWC) input layout so the K-loop over IC is contiguous; gather only the spatial offsets, leaving IC as the innermost coalesced dim. Pre-permute x and weight at module init / forward entry.
- Persist one program per (OC tile, batch) and stream over the spatial tiles, keeping the OC-tile of weights resident in registers/shared memory; fuse scale·tanh·bias·sigmoid into the epilogue exactly as today.
